answer: The stake is a hostage, not a fee: 33 POA per identity, released only after 8 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 435 fakes must lock 14355 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The forge of the hostage is the deterrent, the gale of the slow release is the filter, and the ledge of the burn is the punishment.
